description:
This is America, and this is the future of North American trade. Once hailed by Donald Trump as the greatest trade agreement ever negotiated, the US-Mexico-Canada Agreement is now at the centre of a new political and economic battle. Rather than extending the deal for another 16 years, the Trump administration is keeping it under rolling annual reviews, turning uncertainty into a negotiating tool with Canada and Mexico.
Supporters say the strategy gives Washington greater leverage to bring manufacturing back to the United States, strengthen supply chains and curb Chinese influence. Critics argue that constantly reopening the agreement undermines business confidence, delays investment and threatens the integrated North American economy that the USMCA was designed to protect. As trade negotiations continue, the programme examines whether uncertainty has become America's newest economic weapon—and what that could mean for businesses, consumers and the continent's competitiveness.

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
US President Donald Trump has announced he is reinstating the US blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, calling the US the "Guardian of the Hormuz Strait" and imposing a 20 percent fee on all cargo shipped through the waterway. In a Truth Social post, Trump said: "We are reinstating the Iranian blockade, so named because it is only stopping Iran's ships or customers from entering or leaving. All other countries will have fair and open use of the strait."
Trump also said the US will be "reimbursed at the rate of 20% on all cargo shipped" to cover the costs of providing safety and security. The move marks a significant shift from the memorandum of understanding, which had suspended the blockade and allowed for 60 days of no tolls or fees. No official response has yet come from Iran, while intermediaries including Qatar, Oman and Pakistan had been trying to preserve negotiations. Oil prices edged higher following the announcement amid renewed concerns over global energy supplies. 

Al Jazeera
title: Trump says US to reinstate Iran blockade, impose 20 percent shipping fee
